settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adjust language, graphics, and quality settings.
settings.cost_legend: LOW / MED / HIGH indicates the performance impact of each option. If you experience frame drops, try disabling HIGH-impact options first.

display.section_caption: Choose what appears in the world

decor.label: Decor
decor.description: Shows trees, vehicles and other decor placed on the terrain automatically. Objects you place yourself are always shown.

poi.label: Places
poi.description: Shows nearby place badges (cafes, stores, landmarks, ...) on the map.

structures.label: Buildings
structures.description: Shows or hides buildings on the terrain.

textures.label: Textures
textures.description: Applies detailed textures to blocks instead of flat colors.

tilt_lock.label: Lock Camera Tilt
tilt_lock.description: Locks vertical camera rotation while leaving horizontal rotation free.

edge_shade.label: Block Outlines
edge_shade.description: Darkens only edges exposed to open air, keeping flat ground seamless while outlining changes in height.

off.label: Off
off.description: Applies uniform ambient lighting to all surfaces.

corner.label: Corner (Geometry)
corner.description: Darkens contact areas and inside corners so blocks look grounded instead of floating. Light on performance.

screen.label: Detailed (SSAO)
screen.description: Adds detailed contact shadows to corners and crevices for greater depth. This is the most demanding option because it processes the entire screen.

rim_light.label: Rim Light
rim_light.description: Adds a subtle highlight around the edges of blocks, decor and characters to make them stand out from the background.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Draws at the device's resolution, lowering it for a while when frames stutter and restoring it once there is room.

fixed.label: Fixed
fixed.description: Always draws at the device's resolution. Sharpest, but may stutter on slower devices.

low.label: Low
low.description: Draws at a lower resolution to save battery and heat. Looks a little softer.

lod_crossfade.label: LOD Crossfade
lod_crossfade.description: Blocks fade into their new level of detail as you zoom or move, instead of switching at once. Draws the changing blocks twice while they fade.

debug.section_caption: Diagnostics for the view and the scheduler

profiler.label: Performance Overlay
profiler.description: Shows a panel with frame rate, GPU load, memory use, network requests and task timing.

gizmos.label: Gizmos
gizmos.description: Displays coordinate markers, such as the map center and tile boundaries, for debugging.

disclaimer.demo_notice: This service is a demo. Data may be lost or the service may be discontinued without notice.
disclaimer.coverage_notice: Currently, only South Korea is supported. All other regions are displayed as ocean.
disclaimer.storage_notice: Objects you place are stored only on this device and are not saved to the server.
disclaimer.location_notice: Your location data is neither collected nor stored.
disclaimer.character_notice: Characters and decor use the CC0-licensed Kenney asset pack.

about.tagline: Turn the real world into a canvas and build with blocks.

drawer_modal.title: Drawer
drawer_modal.description: Browse all available block colors, decor, and characters.

geolocation.unsupported: Location services aren’t supported in this environment.

unsupported.title: This browser isn't supported
unsupported.webgpu: This browser has no WebGPU, which is what the world is drawn with. Open the page in a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
unsupported.insecure: WebGPU is only available over HTTPS. Open the page at its https:// address.
unsupported.gpu: WebGPU is here but no graphics adapter answered. It may be disabled or blocked for this GPU.
